10: async function callKernelProcess<T>(payload: string, options: KernelTransportOptions, decode: (payload: string) => T, label: string): Promise<T> {
11:   const command = options.command ?? process.env.TONYMEM_PYTHON ?? "python3"
12:   const args = options.args ?? ["-m", "kernel.boundary"]
13:   const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 5000
14:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
15:     let settled = false
16:     let stdout = ""
17:     let stderr = ""
18:     const child = spawn(command, args, { cwd: options.cwd, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] })
19:     const finish = (response: T) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); resolve(response) }
20:     const timer = setTimeout(() => { child.kill(); finish(fallback<T>(`${label} transport timed out`)) }, timeoutMs)
21:     child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8")
22:     child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8")
23:     child.stdout.on("data", (chunk: string) => { stdout += chunk })
24:     child.stderr.on("data", (chunk: string) => { stderr += chunk })
25:     child.on("error", (error) => finish(fallback<T>(`${label} process unavailable: ${error.message}`)))
26:     child.on("close", (code) => {
27:       if (settled) return
28:       if (code !== 0) return finish(fallback<T>(`${label} process failed${stderr.trim() ? `: ${stderr.trim()}` : ""}`))
29:       try { finish(decode(stdout.trim())) } catch { finish(fallback<T>(`Invalid ${label} response`)) }
30:     })
31:     child.stdin.end(payload)
32:   })
33: }

28:   getByCallId: (callId: string) => ExecutionGraphNode | undefined
29:   getChildren: (id: string) => ExecutionGraphNode[]
30:   getTaskForChildSession: (childSessionId: string) => ExecutionGraphNode | undefined
31: }

33: export function createExecutionGraph(now: () => string = () => new Date().toISOString()): ExecutionGraph {
34:   const nodes = new Map<string, ExecutionGraphNode>()
35:   const callIndex = new Map<string, string>()
36:   const sessionIndex = new Map<string, string>()
37:   const pendingTasks = new Map<string, string[]>()
38:   const taskChildren = new Map<string, string>()
39: 
40:   const get = (id: string) => nodes.get(id)
41:   const getByCallId = (callId: string) => {
42:     const id = callIndex.get(callId)
43:     return id ? nodes.get(id) : undefined
44:   }
45:   const getChildren = (id: string) => [...nodes.values()].filter((node) => node.parentId === id)
46: 
47:   const sessionCreated = (input: { sessionId: string; parentSessionId?: string; startedAt?: string }) => {
48:     const existing = sessionIndex.get(input.sessionId)
49:     if (existing) return nodes.get(existing)!
50: 
51:     const node: ExecutionGraphNode = {
52:       id: `session:${input.sessionId}`,
53:       kind: "session",
54:       ...(input.parentSessionId ? { parentId: `session:${input.parentSessionId}` } : {}),
55:       sessionId: input.sessionId,
56:       status: "running",
57:       startedAt: input.startedAt ?? now(),
58:     }
59:     nodes.set(node.id, node)
60:     sessionIndex.set(input.sessionId, node.id)
61: 
62:     if (input.parentSessionId) {
63:       const queue = pendingTasks.get(input.parentSessionId) ?? []
64:       const taskCallId = queue.shift()
65:       if (queue.length) pendingTasks.set(input.parentSessionId, queue)
66:       else pendingTasks.delete(input.parentSessionId)
67:       if (taskCallId) {
68:         taskChildren.set(taskCallId, input.sessionId)
69:         const task = getByCallId(taskCallId)
70:         const child = nodes.get(node.id)
71:         if (task && child) child.parentId = task.id
72:       }
73:     }
74: 
75:     return node
76:   }
77: 
78:   const taskStarted = (input: { sessionId: string; callId: string; taskId: string; agent?: string; startedAt?: string }) => {
79:     const existing = getByCallId(input.callId)
80:     if (existing) return existing
81: 
82:     const parentSession = sessionIndex.get(input.sessionId)
83:     const node: ExecutionGraphNode = {
84:       id: `task:${input.callId}`,
85:       kind: "task",
86:       ...(parentSession ? { parentId: parentSession } : {}),
87:       sessionId: input.sessionId,
88:       callId: input.callId,
89:       taskId: input.taskId,
90:       tool: input.agent,
91:       status: "running",
92:       startedAt: input.startedAt ?? now(),
93:     }
94:     nodes.set(node.id, node)
95:     callIndex.set(input.callId, node.id)
96: 
97:     const queue = pendingTasks.get(input.sessionId) ?? []
98:     queue.push(input.callId)
99:     pendingTasks.set(input.sessionId, queue)
100:     return node
101:   }
102: 
103:   const taskFinished = (input: { callId: string; status: ExecutionGraphNode["status"]; finishedAt?: string; result?: ExecutionGraphNode["result"] }) => {
104:     const node = getByCallId(input.callId)
105:     if (!node || node.kind !== "task") return undefined
106:     node.status = input.status
107:     node.finishedAt = input.finishedAt ?? now()
108:     if (input.result) node.result = input.result
109:     const queue = pendingTasks.get(node.sessionId)
110:     if (queue) {
111:       const remaining = queue.filter((callId) => callId !== input.callId)
112:       if (remaining.length) pendingTasks.set(node.sessionId, remaining)
113:       else pendingTasks.delete(node.sessionId)
114:     }
115:     return node
116:   }
117: 
118:   const toolStarted = (input: { sessionId: string; callId: string; tool: string; startedAt?: string }) => {
119:     const existing = getByCallId(input.callId)
120:     if (existing) return existing
121: 
122:     const parentSession = sessionIndex.get(input.sessionId)
123:     const task = getTaskForChildSession(input.sessionId)
124:     const node: ExecutionGraphNode = {
125:       id: `tool:${input.callId}`,
126:       kind: "tool",
127:       ...(task ? { parentId: task.id } : parentSession ? { parentId: parentSession } : {}),
128:       sessionId: input.sessionId,
129:       callId: input.callId,
130:       tool: input.tool,
131:       status: "running",
132:       startedAt: input.startedAt ?? now(),
133:     }
134:     nodes.set(node.id, node)
135:     callIndex.set(input.callId, node.id)
136:     return node
137:   }
138: 
139:   const toolFinished = (input: { callId: string; status: ExecutionGraphNode["status"]; finishedAt?: string; result?: ExecutionGraphNode["result"] }) => {
140:     const node = getByCallId(input.callId)
141:     if (!node || node.kind !== "tool") return undefined
142:     node.status = input.status
143:     node.finishedAt = input.finishedAt ?? now()
144:     if (input.result) node.result = input.result
145:     return node
146:   }
